title: Measured violet rabbit reconstruction and reference-matched surface lookdev
acceptance_criteria: Compare actual front, right and back renders with the supplied three-view reference; match the T-pose proportions, thick ears, recessed black eyes, continuous muzzle and deep lower jaw.
Match the subdued worn violet and grey-lilac mottled cloth appearance; avoid bright white belly, stone-like relief, regular cloud grids and excessive gloss.
Preserve an editable packed Blender scene, explicit UVs, reconstructed texture maps, source scripts and the genuine saved reference copy; reopen with no missing external dependencies.
Inspect the exact job version's comparison sheet, face/profile and surface closeups; execution success alone is not visual acceptance.
